module: Energy storage type 'electricBattery': electric vehicle battery. Energy is kept in joules (energyType 'electricEnergy') and configured in kWh in the jbeam. Instantiated by energyStorage.lua from a jbeam entry with `type = "electricBattery"`; electric motors consume it through the powertrain devices.
notes: jbeam fields read: name, type, batteryCapacity (kWh, default 0), startingCapacity (kWh, default = batteryCapacity).
Conversion: 1 kWh = 3,600,000 J. storedEnergy, energyCapacity, initialStoredEnergy are in joules.
Naming anomaly: remainingVolume contains storedEnergy / 3600000, i.e. the energy in kWh, not a volume.
updateGFX rewrites storedEnergy through setStoredEnergy every frame to recompute remainingVolume and remainingRatio; no limit (clamp) is applied to storedEnergy at this point.
setRemainingRatio only updates storedEnergy (the rest is recomputed on the next frame).
No leak, no onBreak, no serialize/deserialize for this type.

new.desc: Creates an electric battery type storage from the jbeam entry. The returned storage is a table with name, type, energyType, assignedDevices, capacity (kWh), startingCapacity (kWh), energyCapacity (J), initialStoredEnergy (J), storedEnergy, remainingRatio, remainingVolume, jbeamData and the methods listed in the 'storage' class.

jbeamData.desc: Merged jbeam data of the storage.

storage.desc: Instance returned by new(jbeamData). Methods are called with the `storage:method(...)` syntax.

setStoredEnergy.desc: Sets the stored energy and recomputes remainingVolume (kWh) and remainingRatio.

setRemainingRatio.desc: Sets the energy to energyCapacity * ratio (ratio clamped between 0 and 1).

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame by energyStorage.updateGFX: recomputes the derived values.

registerDevice.desc: Registers a powertrain device in assignedDevices (by its name).

setPartCondition.desc: Restores the state from the part condition: a number is interpreted as a fraction of energyCapacity, a table must contain storedEnergy.

getPartCondition.desc: Returns the integrity (always 1) and the state {storedEnergy}.

reset.desc: Restores the starting charge (startingCapacity in kWh converted to J).
